messages.text: Please execute the promised Repair. Your Lantern is committed and Wayfarer trades; our Vigil is available for Guard. I accept this month without transport because the route needs rebuilding and the disclosed distribution benefit supplies civilian stores. The repair will demonstrate what your discretion delivers. Our corresponding contribution is real: Spear will lose conditioning while Vigil protects the settlements.
Both Janissariat signatures request Guard without Warrant. Navigation supports the funded Repair; no military passage is available on these assignments.

reason: NG gives the Guild the actual decision, and I am supporting its responsible use. Repair fulfils the upkeep duty, enables safe private Trade from prepared Beacon three, and delivers the disclosed civilian benefit if the trade completes. No unsupported military order improves that bargain.
